query:
UPDATE comms_channels
            SET name = COALESCE($2, name),
                channel_type = CASE
                    WHEN $3 THEN 'team'::comms_channel_type
                    ELSE channel_type
                END,
                team_id = CASE WHEN $3 THEN $4 ELSE team_id END,
                auto_join_team = COALESCE($5, auto_join_team)
            WHERE id = $1
